title: Who Is a God Like You

request.style: English, female solo voice with deep choir, Celtic harp, bodhran, fiddle, tin whistle, flute, haunting and hopeful, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
What misery is mine, gathering fruit after harvest
Like gleaning the vineyard when the grapes are gone
Not a cluster left to eat, not one early fig
The faithful have vanished from the land entirely

[Verse]
Not one upright person remains among us
They all lie in wait for blood in the dark
Each one hunts his own brother with a net
Both hands are skilled at weaving evil tight

[Pre-Chorus]
The official demands his price, the judge takes his bribe
The powerful dictate what they want to do
The best is like a briar, a hedge of thorns
Confusion falls upon them all today

[Chorus]
Who is a God like you, who pardons guilt
Passing over the transgression of his remnant
You do not hold on to your anger forever
For you delight in mercy, yes you do

[Verse]
Put no trust in a neighbor or a friend
Guard your mouth even from the wife in your arms
A son treats his father with contempt
A daughter rises against her mother now

[Pre-Chorus]
Enemies are the members of my own household
Trust is broken and the bonds are torn
But as for me, I will look to the LORD
I will wait for the God of my salvation

[Chorus]
Who is a God like you, who pardons guilt
Passing over the transgression of his remnant
You do not hold on to your anger forever
For you delight in mercy, yes you do

[Bridge]
Do not gloat over me, my enemy
Though I have fallen, I will rise again
Though I sit in darkness, the LORD is my light
I will bear his wrath until he hears me

[Chorus]
Who is a God like you, who pardons guilt
Passing over the transgression of his remnant
You do not hold on to your anger forever
For you delight in mercy, yes you do

[Outro]
You will hurl all our sins into the depths of the sea
You will show faithfulness to Jacob and Abraham
